mapper.select: select h.id,h.create_user,h.title,h.description,h.images,h.contact_type,h.contact,h.type,h.help_type,h.status,h.create_time,u.avatar,u.nickname from help h,user_info u where h.create_user = u.user_id and h.id = #{id}
select count(*) from help where create_user = #{userId} and type = #{type}
mapper.update: update help set comment_count = IFNULL(comment_count, 0) + 1 where id = #{id}
update help set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
